_comment: Verified 'See it in use' videos, one per deal id. Only videos of that EXACT product in use - never search links, never lookalikes, never placeholders. Cards with no entry here get no video link. Future page rebuilds re-apply the links from this file via tools/inject-deal-videos.py. LEGO entries verified Nov 15, 2026 (19/19); viral entries verified Nov 15, 2026 (25/32 with links, 4 no-video, 3 removed as wrong videos in v320). Engagement numbers for the linked videos live in data/viral-metrics.json (single source of truth); the injector appends them to the links (LEGO) and hook lines (Viral).

videos.note: Review video of LEGO Botanicals Flower Arrangement 10345 by BricksDad, showing the finished bouquet and build details.
Top-down build timelapse of the full LEGO Christmas Table Decoration 40743, base through candle and gold stars.
Review video of LEGO Fortune Firecracker 80118 embedded in the Eurobricks review of the set.
just2good review of LEGO Disney Up House 43217, with minifigures and full house build.
Review video of LEGO Technic Volvo L120 Electric Wheel Loader 42209 embedded in the Rambling Brick review; page title and keywords confirm the set.
Unboxing plus timelapse build of LEGO Icons Williams Racing FW14B & Nigel Mansell 10353, with build showcase.
Dad and daughter build and play with the LEGO DUPLO Bluey's Family House with Memory Game 10459 together.
Unboxing and step-by-step build review of LEGO Disney Moana 2 Kakamora Barge 43258, showing the completed barge and play features.
Complete build of all three LEGO BrickHeadz figures in 40752 Carl, Russell & Kevin, shown one by one.
Review video of the completed LEGO Star Wars Grogu with Hover Pram 75403, with posable features and display stand shown.
Full build review of LEGO Harry Potter Enchanted Flying Ford Anglia 76470, chassis through roof, doors and trunk features.
Build of LEGO BrickHeadz Transformers Megatron 40924, robot mode first then the tank vehicle mode, both shown finished.
Speed build of LEGO BrickHeadz The Goblet of Fire Figures 40791, all five figures.
Full build of LEGO Harry Potter Diagon Alley Wizarding Shops 76444; page title confirmed live via browser.open.
Build video of LEGO Ideas Polaroid OneStep SX-70 Camera 21345 embedded in the Adam Insights review of the set.
Creator unboxes and demos the BISSELL CrossWave Hard Floor Expert, cleaning a liquid spill on wood laminate and showing the dirty-water tank.
Creator unboxes the CMF Buds 2 (light blue case), pairs them in the Nothing X app and demos ANC, spatial audio and water resistance.

Reviewer tests the Nothing Headphone (a) for a full week in real life (editing, chores, dog walks, travel) covering sound, ANC and battery. (Color shown in the video not confirmed as the Black deal variant.)
Creator unboxes the CMF Clip Pro with the orange charging case and orange clip earbuds, then wears them to show the fit.
Dad and son unbox, assemble and play with the Hot Wheels City Mega Loop Car Wash, launching cars through the orange loop and car wash.
Hypebeast unboxes the CMF Headphone Pro in light mint green, shows the design and swappable ear cushions, and wears them at the end.
Creator unboxes the Nothing Ear (black box, transparent-lid case), shows the earbuds and app features including ANC and EQ.
Creator reviews the Nothing Ear (3), unboxing the transparent case, demoing the Talk button and Nothing X app, and wearing the earbuds at the gym.
Creator demos the CMF Speaker S milk-carton speaker, plays it at max volume, swaps the front panel for a teal one and tries 3D-printed knobs.
Creator demos the Ninja Blast BC151, blending a banana-date smoothie, sipping from the cup and showing the travel lid.
Creator unboxes the CMF Buds 2a with the matte dark grey charging case and black earbuds inside.
Creator cooks with the Our Place Always Pan 2.0, steaming then sauteing broccolini and plating it with steak and rice.
Creator reviews the Nothing Ear (3a) in bubblegum pink (and yellow), wearing them and covering sound, EQ, Audio Snapshot and ANC.
Creator unboxes the Nothing Ear (a) in black, showing the transparent-lid case and earbuds, then wears one to demo the fit.
Creator unboxes and reviews the CMF Watch 3 Pro with the bright orange strap, powers it on, cycles watch faces and wears it on wrist.
Creator reviews the CMF Buds Pro 2 in orange, unboxing the case, demoing the smart dial and app, and wearing an earbud.
Creator hands-on reviews the CMF Speaker M milk-carton speaker (dark grey), pairing via NFC, removing the front faceplate to show the woofer and tweeter.
Dermatologist rates La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Balm B5 (named as B5, not B5+) as the first product in a viral-skincare roundup, with a user shown applying it.
Kids unbox the Sky Blue Toniebox 2 PAW Patrol bundle at home, revealing the light-blue Toniebox 2, Chase Tonie figure and game pieces.
Phandroid showcases the Nothing Headphone (1) Pro in white, unboxing the case and accessories, demoing the app, and wearing the headphones.
Creator holds the white Nothing Phone (4a) Pro and reviews its cameras, showing the rear module, Glyph Matrix and sample photos.
Creator unboxes the Nothing Ear (Open) in light blue, removes the open-ear buds from the transparent case and hooks one over his ear to demo fit.
